title: Lesson Report – List View – Component – User views lesson report list – Display standard items
description: AC1 Component - Verify standard display items on the list view.
preconditions:
- Actor: HQ or CM Staff
- Existing lesson report with explicit `lesson_name = "Math 101"`, `lesson_date = "2026-06-25"`, `teacher_name = "John Doe"`, `content = "Algebra"`, `next_lesson_homework = "Page 10"`, `next_lesson_announcement = "Test next week"`, `understanding = "Good"`, `in_lesson_quiz = "8/10"`, `homework_completion = "Done"`, and `remarks = "Good job"`.
step_action: Navigate to the lesson report list view
Observe the columns for the lesson report
step_expected_result: The list view displays the columns for Lesson name\
column19: and Remarks matching the expected data

title: Lesson Report – List View – Component – User selects direct edit on group report – Allow inline editing of group lesson report
description: AC2 CRUD - Verify direct editing functionality of a group lesson report.
preconditions:
- Actor: HQ or CM Staff
- Existing lesson report with multiple students.
step_action: Navigate to the lesson report list view
Select Record > Edit for the target group lesson report
step_expected_result: The inline edit mode or edit popup is displayed

step_action: Update the general group lesson report details and save
step_expected_result: The group lesson report is successfully updated and changes are reflected in the list view

title: Lesson Report – List View – Component – User selects direct edit on individual report – Allow inline editing of individual lesson report
description: AC2 CRUD - Verify direct editing functionality of an individual lesson report (Lesson Report Detail).
preconditions:
- Actor: HQ or CM Staff
- Existing lesson report with student sessions.
step_action: Navigate to the lesson report list view
Select Record > Edit for the target individual lesson report detail (student specific)
step_expected_result: The inline edit mode or edit popup for the specific student is displayed

step_action: Update the individual report details (e.g. attendance, score) and save
step_expected_result: The individual lesson report is successfully updated and changes are reflected in the list view

title: Lesson Report – List View – Component – User cancels direct edit – Discard changes
description: AC2 CRUD - Verify direct editing functionality of lesson records (Cancel).
preconditions:
- Actor: HQ or CM Staff
- Existing lesson report.
step_action: Navigate to the lesson report list view
Select Record > Edit for a target lesson report
step_expected_result: The inline edit mode or edit popup is displayed
The edit mode is closed and the original data remains unchanged

title: Lesson Report – List View – Component – User adjusts display – Display settings are applied

- Existing lesson report in the list view.

Open display settings or adjust lesson report display option
Modify display preferences (e.g. toggle columns) and apply
